CAUSE CALLED, THE COURT ORDERED THAT PLAINTIFF NORTHERN CALIFORNIA EQUIPMENT, INC., DOING BUSINESS AS LIGHT SODA ON TAP HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT JAAKSON, AMINA , AN INDIVIDUAL JAAKSON, AMINA , DOING BUSINESS AS CAFE DU LOUVRE JAAKSON, ERKI , AN INDIVIDUAL JAAKSON, ERKI , DOING BUSINESS AS CAFE DU LOUVRE POSSESSION OF THE FOLLOWING DESCRIBED PROPERTY, TO WIT: FOR THE DESCRIPTION OF THE EQUIPMENT, SEE JUEGMENT AT LENGTH., OR IN CASE A DELIVERY OF SAID PROPERTY TO PLAINTIFF CANNOT BE HAD, THEN THAT THE PLAINTIFF HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT $3,005.00 DAMAGES, $305.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,310.00, -PLAINTIFF IS ALSO ENTITLED TO THE RETURN OF THE RESTAURANT EQUIPMENT SPECIFIED IN THE ATTACHED LIST, OR PLAINTIFF IS ENTITLED TO RECEIVE THE VALUE OF THAT EQUIPMENT IN THE AMOUNT OF $6,093.00.
